method: Analyst picks = AI determination: multi-source Week 6 consensus filtered against Kenny's actual Yahoo wire and his no-Dolphins/no-Browns rule. The pure fair-average top 5 is preserved verbatim in math_top5 (no rulebook cuts applied to it).

picks.name: Brenton Strange
picks.why: Back-to-back 8-target games as Jacksonville's starting TE — the role is real, and he's the #1 obtainable add on the consensus board. Catch: JAX is on bye in Week 7, so he's a Week 6 play you then hold through the bye.

picks.name: Pat Freiermuth
picks.why: 4 TDs in 5 games for Pittsburgh. The red-zone role is bankable at a thin position, and he's actually available in most leagues — including Kenny's.

picks.name: Jonah Coleman
picks.why: Denver RB on IR, eligible to return Week 7. Cheap ceiling stash — but note: Kenny's IR is full (Diggs + Monangai), so he'd hold a bench spot until one of them clears.
sources: On waivers, IR-tagged — clears Oct 14 (verified Oct 13)

picks.name: Tank Dell
picks.why: Houston WR on IR-R with elite upside when he's back. Pure ceiling stash — only if you have the bench room to wait.
sources: On waivers, IR-R — clears Oct 14 (verified Oct 13)

picks.name: Tyjae Spears
picks.why: Tennessee's passing-down back. Gets very interesting if Pollard (expiring deal) is moved before the trade deadline.

math_top5.name: Jordan Love
math_top5.why: RotoStreetJournal's #1 overall waiver add for Week 6. Green Bay's starter is that rare waiver QB who works as both a safe weekly streamer and a rest-of-season hold if your quarterback room is shaky.

math_top5.name: Woody Marks
math_top5.why: The strongest consensus on the board: ranked #1 by two sources and #2 by a third. Houston's young back is the week's clearest running-back add.

math_top5.name: Dylan Sampson
math_top5.why: FantasyPros (Horgan) ranks him #2 on the Week 6 list on Cleveland backfield volume. The consensus math puts him here; our judgment layer says the offense around him is the catch.

math_top5.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
math_top5.why: Last Word on Sports' #2 add, on Tennessee target volume. It's the same redundant slot profile that has burned managers before — the judgment layer flags it as a trap.

math_top5.name: Jordyn Tyson
math_top5.why: Top-2 at two of the five sources. Arizona's rookie wideout is an IR stash with a multi-week runway once he's active — the average hides how much the rankers who cover him love him.
